name: Nemotron-3.5-30B-A3B-Antislop-FTPO
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16 (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16: 52 full GQA layers (kv heads 2, head_dim 128) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. A merged BF16 finetune of nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16 — Antislop banlist profiling plus Final Token Preference Optimization to suppress 4,267 overused lexical patterns in the weights. identical tensor set to the base (6,513 names in both safetensors indexes) and the same 32.913 parameters, with a 15.8 MB total shard-size difference between the two repos that is a dtype difference in a handful of tensors, not a structural change; same config.json, same 52 layers, hidden 2688, 262144 max positions. Licence 'other' (NVIDIA Open Model License inherited from the base), repo created 2026-08-11. The three benchmark rows here are recorded because the same-table rule fires, but the card's own statistics block says no benchmark difference is statistically distinguishable from zero and every confidence interval crosses zero — treat them as noise, not as a capability gain. The real claim is 66.41% banlist suppression on 400 held-out Reddit writing prompts with the sampler off, which is a style metric and not a benchmark. HumanEval+ 0.7073 vs 0.7500 and both tau-bench rows went down. The LoRA that produced this checkpoint is a separate repo (thoughtworks/Nemotron-3.5-30B-A3B-Antislop-FTPO-LoRA); this is the merged artefact and so is not an adapter-only derivative.
